posts.title: Point-and-Click
posts.description: If you’re a fan of point-and-click adventure games like I am, Rob Gilbert (the GOAT in this genre) announced yesterday that they started production on Thimbleweed Park 2 coming out in 2028. This is a follow up to the first Thimbleweed Park (2017), which itself is a spiritual successor to previous games Maniac Mansion (1987) and The Secret of Monkey Island (1990).
